BiblicalUsage: Merathayim is the name God gives Babylon in judgment, the land of double rebellion. Jeremiah 50:21 commands, Go up against the land of Merathaim, and against the inhabitants of Pekod, waste and utterly destroy after them.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God names Babylon for what it is before He judges it: a land of rebellion twice over, and its end is already written.
